prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite atlas for a FEMALE ADULT human modular RPG portrait generator. The two previously shown portrait references establish frontal camera, mature proportions, upper-left light, attractive natural human faces. Adapt to refined semi-realistic ANIME illustration with delicate dark contours and smooth restrained cel shading. This is an atlas of COMPONENTS, NOT finished portraits.
Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows equal square cells on a 2048x2048 canvas. Every cell 512x512. No grid lines, no text, no labels. REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA background everywhere outside the sprites.
Coordinate convention within EVERY cell: head center x256, crown y65, eyes y235, nose y290, mouth y332, chin y386, neck bottom y500. Face spans x145..367 at eye height.
ROW 1: four bald FEMALE featureless head+ears+neck bases, oval / softly round / heart / narrow. Skin warm ivory, softly shaded. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO nose, NO mouth, NO hair. Beautiful anatomical face volume with blank smooth central region. Neck tapers out through cell bottom, no shoulders, no clothes. Entire head silhouette opaque. Face frontal symmetric.
ROW 2: four BACK HAIR layers only: straight long hair / wavy long hair / bob / tied-back bun. Hair rendered in neutral medium GRAYSCALE for runtime tinting. Each forms an opaque full hair silhouette behind the future face, with solid filled center (face will be layered over it). Hair crown y45, sides x80..430, length down to y500 except bun/bob. NO face, NO skin, NO eyes, NO body. Hair shading subtle and detailed, not white.
ROW 3: four FRONT HAIR fringe layers only: side-swept bangs / curtain bangs / parted swept crown / soft wispy fringe. GRAYSCALE matching row2. Hair occupies y45..205; lateral locks may extend to y370 only outside x140..372. Completely transparent central face opening below y205. NO head, NO skin, NO eyes, NO body, NO back hair. These are hair cutouts overlaid on the head in row1.
ROW 4: four FLOATING FACE FEATURE sets, one in each cell, all exactly same anchors. Only paired dark eyebrows at y202, paired elegant anime eyes at y235 (left x207 right x305, widths 65, heights 28), delicate nose at x256 y290, feminine closed lips x256 y332. NO face shape, NO skin surround, NO hair. Eyes whites and iris dark gray for recoloring, small highlights, defined eyelashes. Eyebrows y183..211. Eyes y216..260. Nose y268..310. Mouth y315..348. The four variants subtly differ: calm, almond, gentle, sharp. Keep feature layers separated by blank transparent horizontal strips so software can crop eyebrows eyes nose mouth independently.
Critical: all 16 cells aligned with exact same geometry, visual balance, lighting, stylistic consistency. Each sprite fully contained inside its cell with transparent spacing. Do not draw complete portraits, layout decorations, backgrounds, swatches, letters or numbers.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas of clothing and accessory COMPONENTS for adult female sci-fi RPG head-and-shoulders portraits. Refined semi-realistic anime with delicate outlines, soft upper-left illumination, subdued detailed shading. EXACT 2 rows x 4 columns of square equal cells, total 2048x1024 canvas. Transparent RGBA background, no text or grid.
Top row: FOUR HEADLESS women's sci-fi uniform shoulder/chest cutouts, strictly straight-on symmetric view. No heads, no neck skin, no hands. Each sprite width about 450 within its 512 square cell, bottom aligned at cell bottom; open neck socket centered x256 y230, shoulder line y310. Neck opening width 110. Variants: charcoal flight jacket with muted copper piping; high-collared blue-gray naval officer tunic with brass fastener; pearl gray scientist jacket with teal inset; practical olive engineer jumpsuit with orange piping. Detailed tasteful utility clothing, realistic fabric folds, fully clothed busts, no logos.
Bottom row: FOUR individual floating accessory sprites centered in each cell on transparency: thin oval gunmetal eyeglasses in frontal symmetric view (no eyes or head); pair of tiny silver hoop earrings equally spaced with empty center (no ears); small graphite communications earpiece (single item no head); slender pair of copper dangling earrings equally spaced with empty center (no ears). Enough blank space between all cells for automatic extraction. All outside sprites must be truly transparent. Do not add heads or mannequins.
